$comment: Source of truth for Relay skills. `node TOOLS/skills-link.mjs` creates the links (Claude Code only discovers .claude/skills/). Junctions and symlinks do not survive cloud sync: re-run the script on every machine. `load` is 'native' (linked at the root, auto-triggering, its description: is paid for on every session) or 'rag' (no link: found through `rag-query.mjs --type skill` and read on demand). Per-project scope was abandoned: git follows junctions and would have committed a diverging copy of the skill into each project repo.
$rollback: ROLLBACK — if 'rag' mode gets in the way (skills you can no longer reach, friction on load), put everything back to native: `node TOOLS/skills-all-native.mjs` then `node TOOLS/skills-link.mjs`. The script prints what the return costs in tokens per session.

$fields.name: directory name under .claude/skills/, and the name the agent invokes
$fields.src: path under SKILLS/, may be nested (e.g. 'web/scraping')
$fields.why: one line: why this loading mode, so the choice survives the person who made it
$fields.suggest_if: optional regex, tested against a project's file and dependency names; on a match the skill is named in that project's injected state block
$fields.suggest_why: optional short parenthetical shown next to the suggestion
